CITY OF LA VERNE
  DEVELOPMENT REVIEW COMMITTEE
  AGENDA

Eric Scherer, Chair  City Hall
Cody Howing, City Engineer  3660 “D” Street
Richard Martinez, Public Works  La Verne, CA 91750
  (909) 596-8706
  www.cityoflaverne.org

  Tuesday, August 1, 2023 – 9:00 a.m.
  City Hall Large Conference Room
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Development Review Committee meetings are welcomed
and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Development Review Committee with valuable
information. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st Tuesday of every month. In compliance with the American
Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a modification or accommodation in order to
participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the
meeting.

The Large Conference Room will be open to the public at 9:00 a.m. Materials related to an item on this agenda,
submitted to the Development Review Committee after distribution of the agenda packet, are available for
public inspection at the meeting or in the Community Development Department during normal business hours.

  1. CALL TO ORDER

  The meeting was called to order at 9:01 a.m.

  Voting members present: Eric Scherer, Cody Howing, and Richard Martinez.

  Others present: Principal Planner Candice Bowcock, Assistant Planner Gabriel
  Rivera, and Fire Marshal Fred St. Ange.

  2. PUBLIC COMMENT

  This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the Development Review
  Committee on items not listed in any other place on this agenda.
 Development Review Committee Agenda- August 1, 2023
Page 2

  California Law does not allow the Development Review Committee to take action in
  response to your statements at this meeting. Your concerns may be referred to
  staff or set for hearing at a later date.

  None

  3. APPROVAL OF ACTION MINUTES – June 6, 2023

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Mr. to approve the amended minutes
  of the June 6, 2023 meeting. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  4. PROJECT REVIEWS

  Note: Due to time constraints, discussion on these items will be limited to 30
  minutes each.

  A.  PROJECT:  LOT LINE ADJUSTMENT
  CASE NO.:  50-23LLA
  ADDRESS:  1837 WHEELER AVENUE
  Project Planner:  Candice Bowcock

  Deposit Project #: 1401
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: The applicant was not present at the meeting.

  It was moved by Mr. Martinez and seconded by Mr. Scherer to approve Case
  No. 50-23LLA. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  B.  PROJECT:  REASONABLE ACCOMODATION
  CASE NOS.:  44-23RA & 45-23PPR
  ADDRESS:  2749 DAMIEN AVENUE
  Project Planner:  Gabriel Rivera

  Deposit Project #: 1396
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: The applicant was not present at the meeting.

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Mr. Martinez to continue the
  project to the next meeting on September 5, 2023. Motion carried by a 3-0
  vote.

  5. ADJOURNMENT

  2

  The meeting adjourned at 9:19 a.m. The next meeting of the Development Review
  Committee is scheduled to be held on September 5, 2023 at 9:00 a.m. at City Hall,
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750.
